title: Golden Ratio Calculator
description: Apply φ (1.618…) to any value — scaled steps up and down, a golden-rectangle preview and a Fibonacci-style sequence.
howto: Enter any base value (a width, font size, spacing…).
See it multiplied and divided by φ and φ² instantly.
Use the golden-rectangle preview and the generated sequence for layouts.

faqs.a: φ = (1 + √5) / 2 ≈ 1.6180339887. A rectangle is "golden" when its long side divided by its short side equals φ.

faqs.q: How is it used in design?
faqs.a: For pleasing proportions: a 1000px layout splits into ~618px and ~382px columns; type scales (12, 19.4, 31.4…) follow φ steps.
Yes — the preview div uses the exact aspect-ratio 1.618… : 1 computed from your base value.
